    Modifier and Type
    Class
    Description
    static final record 
    WhoCaller.Other
    A who sign-in that no browser session loaded and that is neither a bearer token nor an API key, such as one placed in the security context by the application or a test.
    static final record 
    WhoCaller.Session
    A browser session signed the request in, and the request presents no API key or bearer token beside the session cookie.
    static final record 
    WhoCaller.SessionWithForeignCredential
    A browser session signed the request in, but the request also presents an API key or a bearer token, which was ignored because the session had already signed it in.
    static final record 
    WhoCaller.SignedOut
    No who sign-in: the request is anonymous, or signed in by something that is not who's.
    static final record 
    WhoCaller.Stateless
    A bearer token or an API key signed the request in; no browser session did.
    Methods in org.jwcarman.who.spring.security that return WhoCaller
    Modifier and Type
    Method
    Description
    WhoCaller
    WhoSessionSecurityContextRepository.caller(jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest request, org.springframework.security.core.Authentication authentication)
    Classifies this request's caller by what signed the request in, never by which headers it carries: WhoCaller.SignedOut: no who sign-in; WhoCaller.Session: the browser session loaded the authentication and the request presents no stateless credential (one the constructor's matcher matches); WhoCaller.SessionWithForeignCredential: the session loaded it, and the request also presents an API key or bearer token, ignored because the session signed it in; WhoCaller.Stateless: a bearer token or an API key signed it in, and no session loaded it; WhoCaller.Other: any other who sign-in.
